  "skills": "\n## Skill: multi-agent-task-orchestrator\n**Skill Path**: C:\\Users\\tostring\\.transmagent\\skills\\multi-agent-task-orchestrator\n# Multi-Agent Task Orchestrator\n\n## Overview\n\nA production-tested pattern for coordinating multiple AI agents through a single orchestrator. Instead of letting agents work independently (and conflict), one orchestrator decomposes tasks, routes them to specialists, prevents duplicate work, and verifies results before marking anything done. Battle-tested across 10,000+ tasks over 6 months.\n\n## Core Principles\n\n1. **Single Source of Truth**: One orchestrator holds the state; agents only execute specific subtasks.\n2. **Anti-Duplication**: Before spawning any agent task, the orchestrator checks a central registry to ensure no identical task is already in-flight.\n3. **Quality Gates**: Every agent output must pass a verification step (linting, schema validation, manual review flag) before being accepted.\n4. **Heartbeat Monitoring**: If an agent doesn't report progress within 30 minutes, the orchestrator escalates or re-routes the task.\n5. **Graceful Degradation**: If an agent fails, the orchestrator logs the failure, updates the task status, and optionally retries with a different agent.\n\n## Workflow\n\n```mermaid\ngraph TD\n    Start((User Request)) --> O[Orchestrator]\n    O --> D{Decompose Task}\n    D -->|Subtask 1| Q1[Anti-Dup Check]\n    D -->|Subtask 2| Q2[Anti-Dup Check]\n    Q1 -->|No Duplicate| A1[Specialist Agent 1]\n    Q2 -->|No Duplicate| A2[Specialist Agent 2]\n    A1 --> V1{Quality Gate}\n    A2 --> V2{Quality Gate}\n    V1 -->|Pass| M[Merge Results]\n    V1 -->|Fail| R1[Re-route / Retry]\n    V2 -->|Pass| M\n    V2 -->|Fail| R2[Re-route / Retry]\n    M --> Final[Final Output]\n```\n\n## Task Registration Format\n\nWhen registering a task with the orchestrator, use the following format:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"task_id\": \"unique-task-id\",\n  \"type\": \"analysis | generation | review | data-processing\",\n  \"priority\": \"high | medium | low\",\n  \"input\": Constraints\n\n- NEVER spawn two agents with identical task_id or task description.\n- ALWAYS check the orchestrator's task registry before creating a new sub-agent.\n- If a quality gate fails, update the task status to \"failed\" and log the reason.\n- If an agent doesn't respond for >30 minutes, escalate the task to the orchestrator's pending queue.\n- When merging results, prefer the output of export function getFileName(path: string): string {
  return path.split('/').pop()!.split('\\').pop()!;
}

export function getTokens(text: string): number {
  const normalizedText = text
    .replace(/\\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\\t/g, '\t')
    .replace(/\\"/g, '"')
    .replace(/\\\\/g, '\\');

  const chineseTokens = normalizedText.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5\u3000-\u303f\uff00-\uffef]/g) || [];
  const wordTokens = normalizedText.match(/[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*|\+\+|--|&&|\|\||[<>!=]=?|\d+\.?\d*|[^\s\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g) || [];

  return chineseTokens.length + wordTokens.length;
}

export function createElement(html: string): HTMLElement {
  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const doc = parser.parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
  return doc.body.firstChild as HTMLElement;
}

export function getIcon(is_plugin: boolean): string {
  return is_plugin ? "api" : "ai";
}

export function formatString(template: string, params: any): HTMLElement {
  const formattedText = template.replace(/@(\w+)/g, (match, key) => {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(params, key)) {
      return params[key];
    } else {
      console.warn(`Key "${key}" not found in params`);
      return match;
    }
  });
  return createElement(formattedText);
}

// Helper: Format Message
async function formatMessage(template: string, params: any, role: string): Promise<HTMLElement> {
  const newElement = createElement(template);
  let message = newElement.getElementsByClassName("message")[0] as HTMLElement;

  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(params, "icon")) {
    let menu = newElement.getElementsByClassName("menu")[0] as HTMLImageElement;
    menu.src = `img/${params["icon"]}.svg`;
  }

  if (role === "system") {
    message.innerHTML = await marked.parse(params["message"]);
  } else {
    if (params.image_url) {
      let img = createElement(`<img class="w-1/2 shadow-xl rounded-md mb-1 hover" src="${params.image_url}">`);
      message.appendChild(img);
    }
    let text = createElement(`<div class="message-text"></div>`);
    text.innerText = params["message"] || "";
    message.appendChild(text);
  }
  newElement.dataset.id = params["id"];
  return newElement;
}

async function renderPDF(id: string) {
  totalTime = 0;
  timerInterval = setInterval(async () => {
    totalTime++;
    if (totalTime > 10) {
      if (timerInterval) clearInterval(timerInterval);
      timerInterval = null;
      return;
    }
    try {
      const container = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!container) return;
      
      const pdfUrl = container.getAttribute('data-pdf');
      if (!pdfUrl) return;

      const canvas = container.querySelector('canvas');
      if (!canvas) return;

      const pdf = await (globalThis as any).pdfjsLib.getDocument(pdfUrl).promise;
      const page = await pdf.getPage(1);
      // const textContent = await page.getTextContent();
      const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
      const context = canvas.getContext('2d');

      canvas.height = viewport.height;
      canvas.width = viewport.width;

      const renderContext = {
        canvasContext: context,
        viewport
      };

      await page.render(renderContext).promise;
      if (timerInterval) clearInterval(timerInterval);
      timerInterval = null;
      return;
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.log("renderPDF error: ", error.message);
    }
  }, 500);
}

(globalThis as any).copyCode = (btn: HTMLElement, event?: Event) => {
  if (event) event.stopPropagation();
  const codeToCopy = decodeURIComponent(btn.getAttribute('data-code') || '');
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(codeToCopy).then(() => {
    // Add visual feedback
    btn.classList.add('copied');
    const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check"></i> Copied!';
    setTimeout(() => {
      btn.classList.remove('copied');
      btn.innerHTML = originalText;
    }, 1500);
  }).catch(err => {
    console.log('Copy failed', err);
  });
};

// Toggle code block collapse/expand
(globalThis as any).toggleCodeCollapse = (element: HTMLElement, event?: Event) => {
  if (event) event.stopPropagation();
  
  // Find the container
  const container = element.closest('.code-container');
  if (!container) return;
  
  const contentDiv = container.querySelector('.code-content');
  const collapseBtn = container.querySelector('.collapse-btn');
  const fadeHint = container.querySelector('.code-fade-hint');
  const lineCount = fadeHint?.getAttribute('data-line-count') || '10';
  
  const isCollapsed = container.getAttribute('data-collapsed') === 'true';
  
  if (isCollapsed) {
    // Expand
    contentDiv?.classList.remove('collapsed');
    container.setAttribute('data-collapsed', 'false');
    if (fadeHint) {
      fadeHint.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-arrow-up"></i> Collapse';
    }
    if (collapseBtn) {
      collapseBtn.style.display = 'flex';
      collapseBtn.title = 'Collapse';
      collapseBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-chevron-up"></i>';
    }
  } else {
    // Collapse
    contentDiv?.classList.add('collapsed');
    container.setAttribute('data-collapsed', 'true');
    if (fadeHint) {
      fadeHint.innerHTML = `<i class="fas fa-arrow-down"></i> Expand all ${lineCount} lines`;
    }
    if (collapseBtn) {
      collapseBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }
};

let _api: ElectronAPI | null = null

/**
 * 设置 ElectronAPI 实例（由 main.ts 或 preload 脚本调用）。
 * @param api - 由 Electron contextBridge 暴露的 API 实例
 */
export function setElectronAPI(api: ElectronAPI): void {
  _api = api
}

/**
 * 获取当前已初始化的 ElectronAPI 实例。
 * @throws 如果 ElectronAPI 尚未初始化
 */
function api(): ElectronAPI {
  if (!_api) {
    throw new Error(
      '[electronBridge] ElectronAPI not initialized. ' +
      'Call setElectronAPI() before using any bridge methods.'
    )
  }
  return _api
}

/**
 * 检查 ElectronAPI 是否已初始化。
 */
export function isElectronAPIReady(): boolean {
  return _api !== null
}

/**
 * 设置 ElectronAPI 实例（由 main.ts 或 preload 脚本调用）。
 * @param api - 由 Electron contextBridge 暴露的 API 实例
 */
export function setElectronAPI(api: ElectronAPI): void {
  _api = api
}

/**
 * 获取当前已初始化的 ElectronAPI 实例。
 * @throws 如果 ElectronAPI 尚未初始化
 */
function api(): ElectronAPI {
  if (!_api) {
    throw new Error(
      '[electronBridge] ElectronAPI not initialized. ' +
      'Call setElectronAPI() before using any bridge methods.'
    )
  }
  return _api
}

/**
 * 检查 ElectronAPI 是否已初始化。
 */
export function isElectronAPIReady(): boolean {
  return _api !== null
}

import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, computed } from 'vue'
import { useChatStore } from '@/stores/chat'
import { useAppStore } from '@/stores/app'
import { useAgentLoop } from '@/composables/useAgentLoop'
import { electronBridge } from '@/services/electronBridge'
import ChatContainer from '@/components/chat/ChatContainer.vue'
import ChatInput from '@/components/chat/ChatInput.vue'
import HistorySidebar from '@/components/sidebar/HistorySidebar.vue'
import ConfigPanel from '@/components/config/ConfigPanel.vue'
import ModeToggle from '@/components/layout/ModeToggle.vue'
import ProgressBar from '@/components/layout/ProgressBar.vue'

const store = useChatStore()
const appStore = useAppStore()
const chatContainerRef = ref<InstanceType<typeof ChatContainer> | null>(null)
const chatInputRef = ref<InstanceType<typeof ChatInput> | null>(null)

const {
  userData, infoData, streamData, toolData, addRunning, addThinking,
  enterEnd, startAgentLoop, setMarkedInstance,
} = useAgentLoop()

// ─── Bottom panel state ─────────────────────────────────────────

type BottomTab = 'info' | 'envs' | 'tasks' | 'bgtasks'
const activeBottomTab = ref<BottomTab>('info')

interface LogMessage { time: string; type: string; content: string }
const logMessages = ref<LogMessage[]>([])
const MAX_LOG_LINES = 200

const bottomTabs = [
  { key: 'info' as BottomTab, label: 'Info', icon: 'fas fa-info-circle', badge: null },
  { key: 'envs' as BottomTab, label: 'Envs', icon: 'fas fa-cog', badge: null },
  { key: 'tasks' as BottomTab, label: 'Tasks', icon: 'fas fa-tasks', badge: null },
  { key: 'bgtasks' as BottomTab, label: 'BgTasks', icon: 'fas fa-spinner', badge: null },
]

// Proxy counts from store/envs (simplified: parse from stored data)
const envCount = computed(() => {
  try {
    if (store.chat.envs) {
      const e = typeof store.chat.envs === 'string' ? JSON.parse(store.chat.envs) : store.chat.envs
      return Object.keys(e).length
    }
  } catch {}
  return 0
})

const tasksCount = computed(() => {
  try {
    if (store.chat.tasks) {
      const t = typeof store.chat.tasks === 'string' ? JSON.parse(store.chat.tasks) : store.chat.tasks
      return Array.isArray(t) ? t.length : 0
    }
  } catch {}
  return 0
})

const bgTasksCount = computed(() => store.bgTasks?.length || 0)

function addLog(type: string, content: string): void {
  const now = new Date()
  const time = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour12: false })
  logMessages.value.push({ time, type, content })
  if (logMessages.value.length > MAX_LOG_LINES) {
    logMessages.value = logMessages.value.slice(-MAX_LOG_LINES)
  }
}

// ─── IPC Handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function setupIPCHandlers(): void {
  // UUID
  electronBridge.setUUID((uuid: string) => { store.setUUID(uuid) })

  // Agent running
  electronBridge.agentRunning((data: any) => {
    if (data.group_id && data.uuid && store.uuid !== data.uuid) return
    store.setSubmitting(true)
    const systemMsg = store.getSystemMessage(data.group_id)
    if (systemMsg) {
      addRunning(systemMsg)
      addThinking(systemMsg)
    }
  })

  // Agent idle
  electronBridge.agentIdle((data: any) => {
    if (!data?.group_id) { store.setSubmitting(false); return }
    if (data.group_id && data.uuid && store.uuid !== data.uuid) return
    store.setSubmitting(false)
    const systemMsg = store.getSystemMessage(data.group_id)
    if (systemMsg) { enterEnd(systemMsg) }
  })

  // Streaming data
  electronBridge.streamData((chunk: any) => { streamData(chunk) })
  electronBridge.toolData((chunk: any) => { toolData(chunk) })
  electronBridge.infoData((info: any) => { infoData(info) })

  // User data
  electronBridge.userData((data: any) => { userData(data) })

  // Extra load
  electronBridge.handleExtraLoad((data: any[]) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(data)) return
    data.forEach((item: any) => {
      if (item?.role === 'user') userData(item)
      else if (item?.role === 'system') infoData(item)
    })
  })

  // Questions
  electronBridge.handleQuestions((data: any) => {
    store.setQuestions(data?.questions || data)
  })

  // Clear
  electronBridge.handleClear(() => {
    store.clearMessages()
    logMessages.value = []
  })

  // Init info
  electronBridge.initInfo((info: any) => {
    if (info?.chat) store.setChat(info.chat)
    if (info?.uuid) store.setUUID(info.uuid)
  })

  // Log messages
  electronBridge.handleLog((log: any) => {
    const type = log?.type || 'log'
    const content = typeof log?.content === 'string' ? log.content : JSON.stringify(log?.content || log)
    addLog(type, content)
  })

  // Delete memory
  electronBridge.handleDeleteMemory((data: any) => {
    if (data?.group_id) store.removeMessageByGroupId(data.group_id)
  })
}

// ─── Lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

onMounted(() => {
  setupIPCHandlers()
  startAgentLoop()

  // Initial data fetch
  electronBridge.requestInitData?.()
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  // Cleanup handled by electronBridge internally
})
</script>
